product_claims.claim: Submit your email via the waitlist form to be notified when ProofOnce launches (mailto fallback also offered)
evidence_references: Real Cloudflare Pages Function (functions/api/waitlist.ts) forwards validated submissions to Resend; returns 503 (never fakes success) until RESEND_API_KEY is configured in Cloudflare Pages Production env

Client only shows the success message after the backend returns 200 OK; any error falls back to the mailto link, so no submission can be silently discarded (the exact failure mode the 2026-04-30 recall removed)

Removed 2026-04-30 as UX deception per audit. Re-introduced 2026-07-04 with a real backend (MARC-APPROVED, both the RESEND_API_KEY gate and this exact copy).
